items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: He played a drum on that record with me in the basement, where he was, Shine.

ctx.x: He didn't miss anything. He played a drum on that record with me in the basement, where he was, Shine. Yeah, I know the one. You heard it, well, he played it, he was doing all that with them sticks then.
While he was making the record he was doing it.
